propositions: Version identifiers in pyproject.toml, server.json packages, and uv.lock must all be bumped to 0.11.0 and remain lockstep.
The release commit must pass Gerrit code review (LLM-Review +1, Verified +1) and version-lockstep guards before merging to main.
The release.yml workflow must be dispatched from main with version=0.11.0 and obtain required PyPI environment approval to publish the artifact.
PyPI, GitHub tag/release, MCP Registry, and Homebrew tap must all reflect version 0.11.0 with correct hashes and attestation after publish.
A fresh install of nava-rebar[mcp]==0.11.0 from PyPI must pass the packaged post-publication probe without failure.
